First release of **UniSense**, a UniFi OS-inspired theme for the OPNsense web GUI — with a Network Map.

### Install

On the firewall, as root (console option 8, or SSH):

```sh
fetch -o - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ox1d3x3/unisense/main/install.sh | sh
```

The installer adds the theme and the Network Map page and switches the GUI to UniSense. Run it again to update; add `| sh -s -- --uninstall` to remove it.

### Highlights

- Dark navigation rail, card layout, divider-only tables, rounded controls
- Light, dark and system modes plus six accent colours, from the top bar — no reload
- **Network Map** (Lobby → Network Map): internet → firewall → networks → devices, gateway health, live per-device traffic, search and filters; name any device and pick its icon (stored in the configuration)
- Dashboard widgets restyled; gauges and the CPU graph follow the accent colour
- MVC pages, data grids, dialogs, classic PHP pages, date picker and the sign-in page
- Collapsed icon rail with fly-outs, phone drawer and tablet layouts
- No external requests; no core files changed

Tested against OPNsense 25.7, 26.1 and 26.7 GUI markup.
